consent.headline: Cookies, and what we set them for
consent.body: We need a few cookies to run the site: the language you chose, your basket, the security of your order. Everything else is your call, and we set nothing in those groups until you say yes.
consent.settingsHeadline: Choose which cookies we may set
consent.saved: Your choices are saved. You can change them whenever you like, from “Cookie settings” at the foot of every page.
consent.essentialLocked: These keep the site working — your language, your basket and the security of your order — so they cannot be switched off. We use them whether or not you accept anything else.
consent.categoryEmpty: We set nothing in this group yet. Your choice is recorded for the day we do.

essential.name: Essential
essential.purpose: What the site cannot work without.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.purpose: How many people visit, and which pages help them send flowers. We use it to make the site better, and for nothing else.

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.purpose: Measuring which advertising brought you here, and showing you our flowers elsewhere on the web.

locale.purpose: Remembers the language you chose, so we do not ask again.

localeSuggestionDismissed.purpose: Remembers that you closed the language suggestion, for this visit only.

consent.purpose: Remembers these cookie choices and when you made them: 12 months if you accept anything, 6 months if you refuse everything.

session.purpose: Keeps you signed in while you order. Not set yet — there is no sign-in.

csrf.purpose: Stops a form you send us being forged by someone else. Not set yet — there is no form.

currency.purpose: Remembers the currency you chose to pay in. Not set yet.

basket.purpose: Remembers what you put in your basket. Not set yet.

stripeMid.purpose: Stripe, who handles our card payments, uses it to spot fraudulent payments. Not set yet — checkout is not open.

stripeSid.purpose: Stripe's short-lived companion to the one above, for the same fraud checks. Not set yet.

ga.purpose: Google Analytics: tells one visit from another so a visit is not counted twice. Not set unless you accept analytics.

gaContainer.purpose: Google Analytics: the same, for our own measurement id. Not set unless you accept analytics.

howItWorks.heading: Three people touch your order. None of them is a courier.
howItWorks.intro: You order from us in your own language and currency. Our florist in the recipient's town makes the bouquet the morning it is delivered and hands it over in person. Nothing crosses a border, so there is no customs form and nothing to pay on arrival.

choose.title: You choose the town, the day and a bouquet.
choose.body: Every price is final. The cutoff is shown in the recipient's time, not yours.

make.title: A florist a few streets away accepts it.
make.body: Made that morning with what is in season locally. Substitutions are like for like, and we tell you.

deliver.title: Delivered by hand. You get the photo.
deliver.body: A picture arrives when the flowers do, so you know it happened.

howItWorks.guaranteePending: The full terms go up with our help pages. Until they do, the promise above is the whole of it.

faq.heading: Questions people ask first
faq.allTopicsPending: Our help pages are being written. Until they are up, the answers below are the whole of what we promise.

photo.question: Will the bouquet look like the photo?
photo.answer: Close, not identical. Our florists work with what is fresh that morning and substitute like for like in colour and value. Every change is noted on your delivery photo.

nobodyHome.question: What if nobody is home?
nobodyHome.answer: Our florist calls the recipient first. If they cannot be reached, we agree a redelivery with you, at no charge.

price.question: Is the price really final?
price.answer: Yes. Delivery and VAT are inside the price you see. Your card is charged in your currency for exactly that amount.

whoDelivers.question: Who delivers, and when?
whoDelivers.answer: Our own florist in the recipient's town, by hand, on the day you choose. Order by 14:00 in Warsaw — the recipient's own time — and it arrives today.

lasting.question: What if the flowers do not last?
lasting.answer: Seven days from delivery. Tell us and we redeliver or refund, your choice, no photo required.
